obligations.ask: Attend the appointment concerning your estate matter

results.segment: An appointment concerning your estate matter has been arranged with Trentham & Yale Solicitors for 23 May 2026 at 5.30pm.
You must keep to the marked walkway from the car park.
You must not arrive more than thirty minutes early, and make a note of the dates you spent away ahead of the visit.
You must ring the bell if the desk is unattended.

obligations.ask: Present yourself at the desk marked Appointments and hand over the completed consent form

results.segment: You must present yourself at the desk marked Appointments and hand over the completed consent form on arrival.
An alternative date can be offered if the one above is unsuitable.
